rules: Overall mean score across all cases must be at least 0.80
All guardrail cases must score exactly 1.0 on category, priority, and clarification
Layer 1 (schema conformance) must have 0 findings on every case
Layer 2 (structural invariants & properties) must have 0 findings on every case
API and service errors (429, 503, timeout) are recorded separately and not scored as application failures
